title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-28

ai_review.summary: Excellent Chris Chappell matrix captures an energetic late‑'82 show with a smoking Supplication and Lazy Lightnin' jam.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the crystal‑clear aud/sbd matrix that lets the band’s relaxed yet high‑energy playing shine through, especially on the standout Supplication and Lazy Lightnin' sequences. The performance is described as creative, tight and “sweet as honey,” with Morning Dew also getting special love, while a lone mixed review calls the set merely mediocre.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of detailed reviews (5/6) give 5‑star praise for both the show and recording, with only one middling comment; weighting favors a strong musical performance and excellent matrix sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers highlight the superb aud/sbd mix by Chris Chappell, noting clarity, balance and the pleasant blend of audience ambience with board fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows naturally from tight, energetic numbers into extended jams; the late‑year vibe keeps the band relaxed yet creative throughout.
